answer: Locks are logged in river, expire in basalt, and shale lists each expiry. An adversary running 158 aliases hence needs 94 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3187 identities would post 2841 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
